latin: Quatuor sunt exercitus iuniorum deorum. Primus habitat a primo coelo usque ad principium aeris; secundus inde usque ad dimidium aeris. Tertius inde usque ad terram.
translation: There are four hosts of the younger gods. The first dwells from the first heaven down to the beginning of the air; the second from there down to the middle of the air; the third from there down to the earth.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch4, from Latin at farmer1998:16491
not_established: The Latin as given in the corpus announces four hosts but names only three; whether a fourth clause was dropped in transcription of the source is not established by the material consulted (farmer1998:16564).
No secondary scholarship among the sources consulted discusses this thesis.
